subject: Renewal proposal: per-token pricing + soft-commit options
messages:

Subject: Renewal coming up — discounting and commit questions

Hey Rishi,

Quick note as we start planning our renewal: our consumption has moved faster than expected (Q3 usage attached), and the board wants to lock in a more predictable per-token cost for 2027. Can you share what flexibility you have around:

- Per-token volume tiers (we're interested in >10B tokens/month scenarios)
- Ability to set a softened commit (i.e., a minimum monthly spend that gives us tier discounts but with a lighter true-up)
- Limits on renewal uplift — we want a ceiling so the commercials don't jump significantly at renewal time

Also, any packaging changes we should anticipate if we move to a higher committed tier?

Appreciate a proposal we can discuss next week.

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Head of Platform
NovumAI

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Marco Diaz <marco@novumai.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal coming up — discounting and commit questions

Hi Olivia — thanks for the context and the usage file. High level here and attaching a clean proposal PDF (stub) with numbers. Key ideas: 

1) Soft-commit construct: monthly minimum spend that unlocks tiered per-token pricing. Unused monthly minimums do not automatically roll forward; however, we allow a 60-day grace window where credits can be applied to excess usage in subsequent months (one-time allowance). True-ups are capped at 25% of the committed monthly amount per quarter to reduce surprise billing.

2) Per-token tiers (example):
   - 0–1B tokens: base rate $0.0012/token
   - 1–10B tokens: $0.0009/token
   - 10B+ tokens: $0.00065/token
   
   The effective blended rate depends on the committed band. If you take a 6-month soft-commit at 6B tokens/month, we can move the blended to ~$0.00082/token.

3) Renewal uplift ceiling: we can contractually cap renewal uplift to 20% for the next 12 months after renewal provided the account remains within 80–125% of the committed range. Outside of that, standard review applies.

4) Packaging: moving to a higher committed tier includes access to Dedicated trial credits (50% at first month), and a higher SLA window. No mandatory change to data residency.

I cc'd Lauren to confirm on the uplift cap language and Connor for finance confirmation. I've attached: "NovumAI_Renewal_SOFTCOMMIT_v2_redlines.pdf" (PDF redline stub).

Propose a quick call Thurs 11/19 or Mon 11/23 to walk the proposal.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Questions on soft-commit and overages

Thanks Rishi — a few clarifying questions before the call: 

- If we hit 140% of committed tokens in a month, is the billing just per-token at on-demand rates, or is there a blended true-up?
- Can you confirm whether unused soft-commit credits are "lost" after the grace period? Any chance of a small rollover pool for annual commitments?
- How do SLA credits interact with committed tiers (are credits pro-rated)?

Also need the finance-friendly definition of "renewal uplift" (i.e., is it on list price or our current effective blended rate?).

Marco
Director, Integrations
NovumAI

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Subject: Fwd: Renewal coming up — discounting and commit questions (NovumAI) — pricing ask

Connor / Lauren — forwarding NovumAI thread. High priority: Novum is a strategic logo and their projected token growth maps to material committed revenue. Finance needs to sign off on a firm uplift cap and the 60-day grace window. Proposed responses to Marco's questions: 

- Overages: Bill overages at the on-demand per-token rate but allow a blended true-up option if monthly usage >125% but <150% (true-up capped to 125% price band). Beyond 150% bill at on-demand.
- Unused credits: do not roll by default; for 12-month annual commitments we can offer a 5% rollover pool applied at year-end.
- SLA credits: pro-rated to committed tier; full terms in SLO addendum.

Finance: can we tighten the renewal uplift cap to 18% (rather than 20%) if we add a one-time onboarding credit of $25k and a 90-day auto-rightsize clause? If so, I'll present the package. Please confirm.

Quick thoughts — I like the structure but recommend the following edits before we send a final: 

1) Make the renewal uplift ceiling 18% in writing for 12 months provided they commit to a 12-month soft-commit at >=5B tokens/month.
2) Add a one-time $25k onboarding credit (applied against first 2 months).
3) Adjust the grace rollover: 60-day grace + a 5% annual rollover pool for 12-month commitments (applies only at contract anniversary).
4) Add an auto-rightsize clause: after 90 days, we automatically re-evaluate actual vs committed usage and propose a right-sized tier with 30 days notice; this avoids repeated overage true-ups.

I've redlined the attached PDF with precise language (see NovumAI_Renewal_SOFTCOMMIT_v2_redlines.pdf). Finance approvals needed: Connor to confirm the 18% uplift cap + credit.

Hi Olivia & Marco — thanks for the patience while we aligned internally. Summary of the updated offer we can put on paper: 

- Soft-commit: 12-month soft-commit at 6B tokens/month (minimum). Unused monthly credits do not roll monthly, but there is a 60-day grace window to apply them to subsequent months. Additionally, we will provide a 5% annual rollover pool at the contract anniversary for annual commitments.
- Pricing tiers: as previously shared (0–1B, 1–10B, 10B+) with a blended example of ~$0.00079/token for the 6B/month commitment.
- Overages: usage between 125–150% of committed monthly tokens will be eligible for a blended true-up (capped to the 125% pricing band). Anything >150% billed at on-demand.
- Renewal uplift cap: 18% cap on list-price uplift for 12 months after renewal, conditioned on staying within 80–125% of committed usage.
- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 applied to first two invoices.
- Auto-rightsize: after 90 days we will auto-evaluate and recommend a right-size; any changes require 30 days notice.
